top_five.text: A major earthquake in Venezuela has reportedly killed at least 6,301 people, creating critical emergency response needs across affected communities.
The fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed over 2,000 people among 4,381 cases.
The remnants of Typhoon Dolphin brought severe flooding and forced mass evacuations across Beijing and northern China.
A 7.4-magnitude earthquake in western Colombia killed at least 169 people and injured hundreds, causing widespread destruction of residential buildings.
An Israeli military strike hit the Abu Asi orphan camp in the Gaza Strip, damaging facilities housing displaced civilians.

top_story.quote: A devastating earthquake in Venezuela has left at least 6,301 people dead, generating severe humanitarian needs and urgent demands for emergency response.
top_story.label: AMERICAS — Massive Earthquake in Venezuela

Middle East.headline: Gaza/OPT — Israeli Strike Hits Abu Asi Orphan Camp
Middle East.body: Israeli forces attacked the Abu Asi orphan camp in the Gaza Strip, an area housing displaced residents. Despite sustaining injuries, surviving and wounded individuals continued assisting and caring for other displaced persons at the site. The report did not detail specific casualty figures or the full extent of damage to the facility.

Middle East.headline: Yemen/Red Sea — Houthi Ship Strikes and US Civilian Casualty Investigation
Middle East.body: Conflict in the region escalated following Houthi attacks on shipping vessels in the Bab al-Mandeb Strait and Red Sea. Yemeni officials claimed six people died in a double-tap strike on a vessel, with other reports citing three crew members killed. Additionally, four people were reportedly killed when US forces struck a cargo vessel near the Gulf of Oman. Separately, the US Department of Defense disclosed that US military strikes in Yemen killed 153 civilians last year, with 15 incidents currently under probe.

6 killed claimed in Bab al-Mandeb ship strike

Middle East.headline: Syria — Military Personnel Killed in Qamishli Attack
Middle East.body: The Syrian armed forces reported that two soldiers were killed during an attack in the city of Qamishli. The attack targeted military personnel in the region. Available reporting provided no additional details regarding the responsible parties, specific circumstances, or potential civilian casualties.

Americas.headline: Colombia — 7.4-Magnitude Earthquake Causes Severe Casualties and Destruction
Americas.body: Emergency personnel, soldiers, and volunteers in western Colombia are searching through collapsed apartment blocks and office buildings following a 7.4-magnitude earthquake on Monday morning. The powerful quake caused widespread destruction, leaving many people homeless. According to BBC reporting, at least 169 people were killed. Other reports indicate casualties ranging from 150 to at least 241 deaths, with hundreds more injured. Search and rescue operations remain ongoing as teams race to clear debris and locate survivors.

Americas.headline: Venezuela — Reported Earthquake Death Toll Rises Significantly
Americas.body: The reported death toll from a major earthquake in Venezuela has reached 6,301, according to media coverage. Detailed information regarding specific affected municipalities, structural destruction, secondary hazards, and local search operations remains limited. The reported mortality figure indicates critical emergency response requirements and acute humanitarian needs across impacted communities.

Africa.headline: DR Congo — Ebola Outbreak Surpasses 2,000 Fatalities
Africa.body: Health authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo report that an ongoing Ebola outbreak has killed more than 2,000 people, with total cases reaching 4,381. Described as the fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record, the epidemic involves the accelerating Bundibugyo strain and reportedly began months prior to its official declaration. Containment efforts are being outpaced due to operational challenges, including healthcare workers striking over pay, while international health efforts race to secure vaccines.

Europe.headline: Russia/Ukraine — Cross-border attacks kill four and damage buildings
Europe.body: Overnight attacks in southern Russia and Ukraine resulted in four fatalities and caused damage to dozens of buildings. Local authorities in the Russian port city of Novorossiysk reported extensive damage to structures following night-time strikes, confirming that a child was among those killed. The casualties and property destruction reflect the continued risks to civilian populations living in proximity to critical infrastructure and port facilities in the region.

Europe.headline: Ukraine/USA — Human Rights Watch cautions against cluster munition transfer
Europe.body: Human Rights Watch has urged the United States not to transfer outdated cluster munitions stored in Türkiye to Ukraine. The warning underscores humanitarian protection concerns associated with cluster submunitions, which frequently fail to detonate on impact and pose severe, long-term explosive risks to civilian populations.

Asia-Pacific.headline: Mass evacuations in Beijing as Typhoon Dolphin brings more torrential rain to China
Asia-Pacific.body: Forecasters warned the Chinese capital could receive more than one-third of its average annual rainfall over 24 hours Thousands of people have been evacuated from areas at risk of flooding and landslides in Beijing, as the remnants of Typhoon Dolphin continue to bring torrential rain to northern and central China. Forecasters warned on Tuesday that the Chinese capital could receive more than 150mm of rain over the following 24 hours, with some districts forecast to exceed 200mm – more than one-third of Beijing’s average annual rainfall of 528mm.
